scope: Focused literature and implementation review; no new GPU measurements or implementation changes.

papers.scope: Primary-paper component of bounded pivot review, checked 2026-11-09. No GPU experiments or artifact executions.

primary_sources.title: PROBE: Co-Balancing Computation and Communication in MoE Inference via Real-Time Predictive Prefetching
primary_sources.authors: Qianchao Zhu; Xucheng Ye; Yuliang Liu; Haodong Ouyang; Chengru Song
primary_sources.method: Distilled next-layer predictor; joint replication and token assignment; exposed transfer cost and per-sender/receiver hiding budgets.
primary_sources.artifact_observation: No own implementation link located in retrieved fulltext; no code executed.
primary_sources.boundary: Eight Hopper GPUs and large BF16 models; predictor and runtime changed together.

primary_sources.title: Director: Accelerating Distributed MoE Serving via Online Proactive Expert Placement
primary_sources.read: Full HTML; especially sections V–VI and evaluation setup
primary_sources.method: Cascade activation prediction, relaxed placement optimization, migration in compute windows.
primary_sources.artifact_observation: No own code link located in retrieved fulltext.
primary_sources.boundary: Approximation result applies to optimization formulation, not an end-to-end runtime guarantee.

primary_sources.title: vExpert: Virtualizing Expert Storage for Adaptive Load Balancing in Distributed MoE Inference
primary_sources.status: Reviewed arXiv preprint; author repository says NeurIPS 2026, proceedings entry not independently established
primary_sources.read: Full HTML; especially sections 3.2 and 4.1; author README
primary_sources.method: Virtual expert storage, cross-layer budgets, compute/A2A gain minus transfer and contention model, periodic allocation.
primary_sources.artifact_observation: Public repository and documentation accessible; SGLang v0.5.1 fork, modified DeepGEMM/DeepEP and IPC CUDA dependencies. Not built or run.
primary_sources.boundary: Eight nodes of eight H100s; DeepSeek-oriented implementation and topology-specific coefficients.

primary_sources.title: Libra: Effective yet Efficient Load Balancing for Large-Scale MoE Inference
primary_sources.authors: Jaehoon Yang; Yushin Kim; Seokwon Moon; Yeonhong Park; Jae W. Lee
primary_sources.version: Official proceedings abstract and current author artifact
primary_sources.read: Official abstract, full author README, .gitmodules, Libra-Core README, public metadata for both submodules; full PDF retrieval blocked/timed out
primary_sources.method: Next-layer lookahead, locality-aware temporary replication, local-before-remote compute, overlapped CPU token sharding and AllGather.
primary_sources.artifact_observation: Libra-Core and Libra-Internal both public; SGLang v0.4.10 forks and reproduction documentation. No execution.
primary_sources.boundary: Eight H200s, prefill; baseline trace/table reproduction up to about 0.6 TB and hundreds of GB of host RAM.

primary_sources.title: Least-Loaded Expert Parallelism: Load Balancing An Imbalanced Mixture-of-Experts
primary_sources.authors: Xuan-Phi Nguyen; Shrey Pandit; Austin Xu; Caiming Xiong; Shafiq Joty
primary_sources.read: Full HTML; sections 3.2, 4 and 5.3; repository README
primary_sources.method: Exact current loads; temporary expert weights and token spill; capacity and minimum GEMM size; imbalance threshold falls back to standard EP.
primary_sources.artifact_observation: Public benchmark code and example launch in README; not run.
primary_sources.boundary: Temporary replication rather than replacement of long-lived placement; small workload can lose.

primary_sources.title: UltraEP: Unleash MoE Training and Inference on Rack-Scale Nodes with Near-Optimal Load Balancing
primary_sources.method: Fixed main layout plus temporary replicas and quotas; GPU-native solver; replica distribution and token reroute modeled alongside compute.
primary_sources.artifact_observation: No own public implementation link found in fulltext; dependency references are not a complete artifact.
primary_sources.boundary: Rack-scale node fabric and persistent streaming transport; also includes training results that are not inference evidence.

primary_sources.title: Patterns behind Chaos: Forecasting Data Movement for Efficient Large-Scale MoE LLM Inference
primary_sources.read: Full HTML; empirical patterns, section VI-B, artifact appendix; dataset access limits supplied by parent from primary card
primary_sources.method: Request/layer-dependent activation structure; prefill-guided remap/duplication and oracle comparisons; distinct wafer-scale simulation.
primary_sources.artifact_observation: Code links and gated dataset card; dataset not downloaded or used.
primary_sources.boundary: Reported real-GPU improvement is MoE computation, not complete inference. Dataset ~199 GB, gated identity/terms, 235B–1T models; selected IDs do not establish availability of replay hidden states or combining weights; decode cap128.

primary_sources.title: Fiddler: CPU-GPU Orchestration for Fast Inference of Mixture-of-Experts Models
primary_sources.authors: Keisuke Kamahori; Tian Tang; Yile Gu; Kan Zhu; Baris Kasikci
primary_sources.read: Full HTML; CPU/GPU placement and profile-based cost comparison; author repository README
primary_sources.method: Choose CPU execution versus GPU fetch based on profiled compute/transfer cost and residency.
primary_sources.artifact_observation: Public code; README describes earlier proof of concept and narrower model/hardware support than final paper. Not run.
primary_sources.boundary: Memory-constrained hybrid inference is a different action space from resident EP migration.

primary_sources.title: ProMoE: Fast MoE-based LLM Serving using Proactive Caching
primary_sources.authors: Xiaoniu Song; Zihang Zhong; Rong Chen; Haibo Chen
primary_sources.status: Reviewed arXiv preprint; no proceedings established
primary_sources.read: Full HTML; sections 4.1, 4.3 and 5; repo README and directory inventory
primary_sources.method: Prediction quality combines accuracy and on-time arrival; demand-prioritized speculative prefetch, chunk preemption, stale-task cancellation.
primary_sources.artifact_observation: Public src/tests/eval directories; README refers to external script and predictor directories. No turnkey reproduction established.
primary_sources.boundary: Offloading/cache system; predictor training and runtime integration costs required.

primary_sources.title: MoE-Infinity: Efficient MoE Inference on Personal Machines with Sparsity-Aware Expert Cache
primary_sources.status: Reviewed arXiv preprint; no proceedings established
primary_sources.read: Full HTML; sections 4.5–4.6; current author repo README
primary_sources.method: Request-level activation matrix matching, future-expert probability and layer-proximity cache priorities.
primary_sources.artifact_observation: Public runtime; README explicitly separates public Hugging Face version from paper performance version. Not run.
primary_sources.boundary: Paper focus single-user/batch-one limited-memory inference; current repository support does not reproduce paper automatically.

primary_sources.title: FreeBalance: Pre-Routing Online MoE Load Balancing via Residual Workload Prediction
primary_sources.read: Fulltext read in preceding review; sections 3.3 and 4.3 checked against saved audit
primary_sources.method: Residual-stream prediction, slot-preserving swaps, positive-gain filter and rank/link overlap budgets.
primary_sources.artifact_observation: No implementation/trace link located in retrieved fulltext.
primary_sources.boundary: 95% success is whole swap-plan completion, not individual-swap accuracy; fixed-swap baseline is not a cooldown.

industry.scope: Five primary engineering blog posts and one official engineering guide; focused industry supplement, not an exhaustive literature review.

selected_sources.title: DeepSpeed: Advancing MoE inference and training to power next-generation AI scale
selected_sources.type: Company engineering/research blog with linked research paper
selected_sources.method: Critical-path parameter grouping, expert/tensor parallelism, communication optimization, and fused kernels.
selected_sources.evidence_limit: Headline speedups combine several system and model interventions; they do not isolate a migration admission rule.
selected_sources.actionable_transfer: Measure the union of active expert weights and actual latency, not only tokens or FLOPs.

selected_sources.title: Scaling Large MoE Models with Wide Expert Parallelism on NVL72 Rack Scale Systems
selected_sources.type: Company engineering blog; main article read separately from its AI-generated summary
selected_sources.method: Grouped GEMM weight reuse, static/online expert placement, graph-compatible containers, and custom communication.
selected_sources.evidence_limit: Rack-scale GB200 comparisons combine topology and software. They do not predict a two-H100 gain.
selected_sources.actionable_transfer: Treat kernel granularity and hardware movement cost as part of placement's objective.

selected_sources.title: Scaling LLM Inference: Innovations in Tensor Parallelism, Context Parallelism, and Expert Parallelism
selected_sources.method: Two-shot token all-to-all, with dynamic and persistent communication strategies discussed.
selected_sources.evidence_limit: Reported communication fractions are configuration-specific; no artifact isolating a placement selector is supplied in the EP section.
selected_sources.actionable_transfer: Profile host overhead, handle exchange, and communication separately. Current all-reduce harness cannot validate its all-to-all mechanisms.

selected_sources.title: The vLLM MoE Playbook: A Practical Guide to TP, DP, PP and Expert Parallelism
selected_sources.type: Company engineering guide with configuration benchmarks
selected_sources.method: Separates parallelism layouts, replicated-input TP+EP/all-reduce and request-sharded DP+EP/all-to-all.
selected_sources.evidence_limit: Mostly single-node MI300X and particular models; concurrency cutoffs are not H100 constants. Inspect pinned implementation before reusing version-sensitive statements.
selected_sources.actionable_transfer: Keep execution path explicit and avoid inferring all-to-all benefits from our replicated-input layer.

selected_sources.title: Improving DeepEP MoE Load Balance in SGLang with Waterfill and LPLB
selected_sources.author: NVIDIA Team
selected_sources.type: Vendor-authored community engineering blog, not a corporate-hosted blog
selected_sources.method: Shared-expert dispatch and per-batch min-max LP allocation across existing redundant replicas; no expert-weight migration for LPLB.
selected_sources.evidence_limit: Blog matrix: 16 Hopper GPUs, DeepSeek-V3 FP8, DeepEP, batch1000/concurrency256/max_tokens1; configuration-level comparisons without uncertainty intervals in the displayed table. Zero-replica regressions are disclosed.
selected_sources.actionable_transfer: Existing replicas provide an alternative actuator; charge counting, collective and solver overhead. Waterfill does not apply to a layer without shared experts.

selected_sources.title: MoE Performance Guide
selected_sources.type: Living engineering documentation, not a blog
selected_sources.method: Module benchmark sweeps with explicit configurations and serving cross-validation; fixed-cost versus data-volume interpretation.
selected_sources.evidence_limit: Published decision tree uses Blackwell workloads and perfect routing; thresholds are not portable to H100/Qwen.
selected_sources.actionable_transfer: Use actual kernel measurements and raw slowest-rank timings; verify routing realization and an external replay rather than trusting ideal routing.

artifact_checks.read_via: GitHub connector, pull request body and metadata
artifact_checks.limits: At this revision DeepSeek-v2 paths only; Qwen3 idle collective participation not supported. Requires DP-attention, DeepEP, SM90 or newer, Math-DX. Separate PR benchmark uses three repetitions and reports all p-values above 0.05; do not pool with blog matrix. Current Qwen support has not been established by this check.

Documents native/projected/forced routing, actual versus requested configurations, raw forward timings, and profiling limitations. Forced routing is not directly equivalent to native scoring. Adopt methodology without claiming backend portability.

Standard online EPLB: decayed counts and cyclic layer updates. New per-layer helper slots avoid redundant copies, but require Blackwell/NVFP4/multicast and MegaMoE CuteDSL; not an H100 baseline. Expert-ID counting overhead is explicitly warned about.

screened_but_not_selected.reason: Changes learned logical routing and training; not a semantics-preserving placement change on this checkpoint.
RL/training orchestration and EFA scale differ from the bounded layer question; not used for an inference-selector claim.
Useful hardware-specific overhead warning and migration controls, but NPU thresholds do not transfer to H100; community documentation, not a large-company blog.

industry.recommended_pivot: Runtime-aware small-change expert placement with an explicit payback/abstention test, conditional on finding profitable actions in a prespecified real-trace pilot.
